title: A UAP hits the team with an energy weapon during a turn

tellings.quote: constantly. During U-turn before he managed to get up on NAYA, NAYA hit us energy weapon.

plain: In 2025, during a field operation by Skywatcher, a startup that says it can call UFOs to appear, a UAP (an unidentified anomalous phenomenon, the official term for a UFO) struck the team with an energy weapon while they were making a U-turn, according to James Valor, who says he was there. He tells Michels it happened "constantly" and that the hit came before a colleague could get to something he calls NAYA, which the telling does not explain. If true, it would mean these objects can respond to people, and harm them.
